authority: This file is the reviewed allowlist for every Rust source file in medusa-process-containment. Any source addition, move, classification change, or unsafe-code exception requires an architecture and security review.

files.reason: Uses the reviewed FlatBuffers Follow accessors only after the real verifier has validated the containment table; the unsafe parser boundary and regression test remain isolated in this low-level crate.
Calls the Windows composable-sandbox, process, pipe, environment, library-loader, and Job Object APIs while owning every returned handle and allocation.

Uses descriptor-relative Unix open/openat calls with O_NOFOLLOW so preview reads are bound to one opened directory capability and the same final file handle is validated and read; Windows uses safe standard-library handle options to pin ancestors and reject reparse points.

Acquires immutable native process-creation identity using reviewed Windows process-time and macOS libproc APIs; Linux uses procfs without unsafe Rust, while all FFI remains isolated in this low-level module.

Uses Unix kill(2) only to signal Medusa-owned dedicated process groups and delegates Windows descendant ownership to the reviewed Job Object boundary; all unsafe operations retain local safety rationale.
Calls Windows Job Object, process, thread, snapshot, and handle APIs and declares Send/Sync only for the owned Job Object handle wrapper.
Calls Windows token, SID, security-descriptor, ACL, and local-allocation APIs while validating returned structures and closing or freeing every owned resource.

review_requirements: Only modules classified unsafe-ffi may receive a local module declaration exception.
Every unsafe operation or logically grouped operation must retain a nearby SAFETY rationale.
New or moved Rust source files fail CI until this inventory is explicitly updated.
Changes to this policy, the checker, or an unsafe module require the CODEOWNERS security review.
